title: contract/v<n>.json - one version of a run's contract (schema contract/1)
description: runs/<id>/contract/v<n>.json, written only by src/contract-record.js and never edited: an amendment is a new version that names the one before it. The ledger (gate-ledger.jsonl) is the authority for which version is current; a version file without a ledger line has no authority, and `council contract check` fails on it. Every field but the obligations' words is written by the harness: a model's draft supplies only id, text, criterion and check (src/contract-lint.js). Tamper-evident, not tamper-proof: whoever can write the run folder can rewrite the record, its approval and the ledger together, and nothing detects that.

supersedes.description: null for version 1; version n-1 for every later version.

run.description: the run folder's name when the contract was locked.

source.description: What the run's report.json said the contract is made from (its thin contract); null where the run recorded none.

sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of { id, text, criterion, check } (an absent one is null).

request_seq.description: the ledger line of the request a person approved.

approval.description: The gate a person approved, and the exact text they were shown: the contract text for version 1, the amendment text for a later version. `check` recomputes that text and compares its hash.

sha256.description: sha256 of the record without this field, as JSON with every object's keys sorted and no whitespace (src/thin-contract.js canonicalJson).
